                                Be going to

                                FUTURE · BE GOING TO

                                🎯 PLANS, INTENTIONS & PREDICTIONS WITH EVIDENCE

                                · Form am / is / are + going to + base verb

                                Pronoun✅ Affirmative❌ Negative❓ Question
                                II'm going to playI'm not going to playAm I going to play?
                                you / we / theywe're going to playwe aren't going to playAre we going to play?
                                he / she / itshe's going to playshe isn't going to playIs she going to play?

                                💬 Short answers: Yes, I am. · No, she isn't. · Yes, they are.

                                · We use it for…

                                UseExamples
                                plans and arrangements for the general futureI'm going to study medicine.
                                intentions & resolutionsThis year I'm going to read ten books.
                                predictions based on evidence (what you can see now)Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.

                                ⚠️ going to + base verb: I'm going to play (not playing) · in spoken English it often sounds like gonna

                                Present continuous

                                FUTURE · A REVIEW

                                📅 WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW… AND WHAT'S IN YOUR DIARY

                                · Form am / is / are + verb-ing

                                Pronoun✅ Affirmative❌ Negative❓ Question
                                II'm playingI'm not playingAm I playing?
                                you / we / theythey're playingthey aren't playingAre they playing?
                                he / she / ithe's playinghe isn't playingIs he playing?

                                💬 Short answers: Yes, I am. · No, he isn't. · Yes, they are.

                                ➕ most verbs: + ing

                                play → playing · read → reading

                                ✂️ final -e: drop the e

                                write → writing · dance → dancing

                                ✌️ short vowel + consonant: double it

                                swim → swimming · run → running · sit → sitting

                                🔁 -ie → -ying

                                lie → lying · die → dying

                                🕒 NOW

                                actions happening at the moment

                                I'm reading a book right now.

                                📅 FUTURE

                                arrangements: the time expression tells you it's the future!

                                I'm meeting Sara tomorrow at 5.

                                Future

                                The rules

                                · Will 🔮 predictions, hopes & quick decisions

                                ✅ I will (I'll) go❌ I will not (won't) go❓ Will you go?

                                We use it for…Examples
                                far future you can't do anything aboutThe sea turtles will go extinct.
                                predictions without evidenceI think it will rain tomorrow.
                                spontaneous decisionsYou look tired: I'll help you!
                                hopes, wishes and requestsI hope you'll come. Will you help me?
                                promises and threatsI won't tell anyone! · Stop or I'll scream!

                                · Be going to 🎯 plans & intentions

                                ✅ I am going to go❌ she isn't going to go❓ Are you going to go?

                                We use it for…Examples
                                plans and arrangements for the general futureI'm going to study medicine.
                                intentions & resolutionsThis year I'm going to eat less sugar.
                                predictions based on evidenceLook at those clouds! It's going to rain.

                                · Present continuous 📅 things in your diary

                                ✅ we are meeting❌ he isn't meeting❓ Are you meeting…?

                                We use it for…Examples
                                appointments (dentist…)I'm seeing the dentist at 4 tomorrow.
                                fixed plans with specific times or dates (parties…)We're having a party on Saturday.
                                programmed events (flights, weddings…)My cousin is getting married in June.
                                verbs of movement, to avoid repetitionI'm going to the cinema (not going to go)

                                · Present simple 🚆 timetables & schedules

                                We use it for…Examples
                                timetables (trains, buses, flights)The train leaves at 7:15 tomorrow.
                                programs and calendars (school, films, concerts)School starts on September 14th.

                                💬 In spoken English going to often sounds like gonna: I'm gonna stop using plastic!

                                IT'S GOING
                                TO BE EPIC!

                                4.1 Highlight the future

                                click the verbs that talk about the future

                                Hey there! I'm writing to let you know about this talent show our school is hosting next month. Everyone's buzzing about it, and I know it'll be epic. So, here's the scoop: I am going to finish one of my paintings live on stage. Not only it's going to be my first time painting with an audience, but also the first time I'll show my work to anyone but you. I will surely be nervous! Will I be any good? Will I choke under the spotlight? I'll do anything to avoid it! I've decided: from now on I'm going to paint every afternoon from 7 to 8 at least; I'm following an online course on creative illustration every Friday and I'm sketching non-stop. This way I am going to give a good performance! So, mark your calendars! I really hope you'll be in the audience so I'll look at you and calm down if I freak out. My slot is at 4 PM, April 13th. Love you, I really wish you'll come.
